original_ai_output.title_zh: 世卫组织称尼日利亚无埃博拉病例，患者已转运至瑞士
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比表示，在患者及其丈夫被医疗转运至瑞士后，尼日利亚目前没有埃博拉病例。尼日利亚将继续监测52名接触者，瑞士负责患者后续治疗及其丈夫的监测。贾纳比称患者经尼日利亚医疗团队救治后临床状况稳定，但强调仍需保持警惕。

key_facts.fact: 世卫组织表示尼日利亚目前没有埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: says Nigeria currently has no Ebola cases following the medical evacuation of the patient and her husband to Switzerland

key_facts.fact: 患者及其丈夫为瑞士公民，已被医疗转运至瑞士
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the evacuation took place earlier in the morning, noting that both the patient and her husband were Swiss citizens

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚将继续监测52名接触者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria would continue monitoring 52 contacts, while Switzerland would manage the patient and follow up her husband

key_facts.fact: 世卫组织强调尽管已完成转运，仍需保持警惕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: vigilance remained critical despite the evacuation, urging continued attention to contact monitoring and other response measures

uncertainties: 事件信息目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
